Reverted afterwards. Static catalog/test evidence only; no real clone/build/run lifecycle was exercised.

edgeCase.summary: Introduced two port-isolation violations (a duplicate target port and a Run-step dependency port colliding with another target); the repository's TestPortsUniqueAcrossCatalog failed with exit 1 naming both colliding owners each time, then passed (exit 0) after revert. Covers duplicate ports declared in the catalog only, not host port-in-use or shared Tomcat instances.

unverified: No real target lifecycle (git clone, Maven/JDK build, run, HTTP readiness, open, stop) was exercised in this replay; the earlier replay cited in SKILL.md (egovframe-launcher#9) was not re-verified.
